Reinvestment of the portfolio at higher yields (direction observed, size NOT_VERIFIED)
invalidationConditions: Close below the 200-day average while its 63-session return is negative (the G3 condition becoming true)
Production entry state moving to AVOID
A reported quarter with an underwriting loss (combined ratio above 100) not explained by a single named catastrophe
Underperforming SPY by more than 10pp, after costs, at any month-end before the 126-session horizon
picks.name: Travelers Companies (The)
notVerified: catastrophe exposure for the coming season
any news after the model's training cutoff
reasons: A profitable, moderately levered insurer (ROE about 27%) priced below the index multiple
Near-zero equity beta and a shallow drawdown: it diversifies the 90% SPY residual while VIX is 28
The production entry layer is ACCUMULATE_GRADUALLY, and no frozen gate or contradicting layer applies
risks: A sharp equity rally: with beta near 0 it would lag SPY
A softening commercial P&C pricing cycle
The FCF yield includes insurance float and overstates distributable cash
picks.thesis12m: Over a year, the stock tracks underwriting profitability plus investment income on a book that reinvests at higher yields. At a below-market multiple it does not need multiple expansion to keep pace with SPY.
picks.thesis6m: If the US correction deepens or stays choppy (VIX near 28), a low-beta insurer earning high returns on equity should hold value better than SPY. The 10% sleeve should then add relative return.
picks.whyVersusBenchmark: Its return driver (underwriting plus investment income) is largely independent of SPY's growth-heavy driver. A 10% sleeve tests whether a profitable low-beta name can beat the index after costs, without betting the book.

reviewedRejected.reason: Risk layer contradicts. Cheapness on cyclical earnings is not evidence of mispricing without margin data.
Only 1 layer supports. The quality signal is an accounting artifact, the valuation basis (FFO) is missing, and the macro layer is adverse.

known: Production 판단: SPY 100%. 알파 정렬 미확인(rank IC t 0.17). QQQ는 별도 비교 기준이다.

KRW 'no-look-ahead' 환산 주장은 철회됐다(H.10 공표 시점). USD 결과는 그대로다.
